description: Send a PDF or scanned image as base64 and extract structured tables into clean CSV and JSON rows. Merges multi-page tables and skips repeated page headers automatically, supports comma/semicolon/tab/pipe delimiters, UTF-8 or Excel UTF-8 BOM encoding, optional Page column, and automatic Tesseract OCR fallback for scanned pages. Deterministic local engine (pdfplumber + tesseract), 0 AI, up to 15 pages per call. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.005/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/pdf-to-csv.

delimiter.description: CSV column delimiter: comma (,), semicolon (;) for EU Excel, tab (TSV), or pipe (|)

fileContent.description: The PDF or image file as base64, max 20 MB (empty = built-in 2-page sample PDF)

includePageColumn.description: Add a Page column showing which PDF page each row came from

mergePages.description: Merge continuing tables across pages and skip repeated header rows

mode.description: tables (tables & columns, default), all (tables + text lines), or split (one CSV per table/page as ZIP)

stripEmpty.description: Remove blank rows and trim extra whitespace

name: pdf_to_csv
title: PDF to CSV API - extract tables from PDFs and scans into clean CSV
